7. Objective: Establish clear guidelines for employee time off and leave requests. 
8. Scope: Applies to all full-time and part-time permanent staff. 
9. Annual Leave Allocation: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per year. 
10. Accrual Rate: Leave accrues at a rate of 1.66 days per completed calendar month. 
11. Probationary Exclusions: Employees under probation cannot request paid annual leave. 
12. Sick Leave Provision: All employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year. 
13. Sick Leave Documentation: Medical certification is required for sick leave exceeding 2 
consecutive days.

emergencies.

1. ANNUAL PAID TIME OFF (PTO) ACCRUAL
All full-time regular employees accrue Paid Time Off (PTO) at the end of each completed calendar month of service.
Accrual rates are determined strictly by employee tenure as measured from the official employment start date:

25 to 60 Months (3-5 Years) 1.66 Days / Month 20 Days 30.0 Days
61+ Months (5+ Years) 2.08 Days / Month 25 Days 37.5 Days

4. Device Management & Remote Work Security
To ensure seamless and secure remote work operations, the following protocols must be maintained: 
Mobile Device Management (MDM): All laptops and smartphones accessing corporate systems must be enrolled
in the SocialEagle MDM agent.
VPN Requirement: Employees connecting from external networks must utilize the corporate VPN with full-tunnel
encryption.
Physical Security: Devices must not be left unattended in public spaces. Screen locks must be engaged when
leaving the desk.
Encryption: Full-disk encryption (BitLocker / FileVault) is enforced across all endpoints.
CRITICAL: Incident Reporting Protocol
If a corporate device is lost, stolen, or compromised, the employee must report it to the IT Security Desk within 1
hour at security@socialeagle.com or via the emergency hotline.
